service.description: New e-Shram registration for an unorganised worker with Aadhaar OTP; the UAN card is made at once.
service.depending: Aadhaar Card, mobile number linked with Aadhaar, bank account details (account number and IFSC), nominee name and date of birth
service.rules: For unorganised workers aged 16–59 who are not EPFO / ESIC members and do not pay income tax. Give the UAN card to the customer.
